mapper.select: /* 단계별 프롬프트 조회 proposal.selectPromptByStep */ SELECT A.PROMPT_ID , A.PROMPT_NAME , A.PROMPT_TYPE_CD , A.CONTENT , A.APPLY_LLM_YN , A.USE_YN , B.STAGE_CD FROM TB_PROMPT A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_PROMPT_APPLY_AGT B ON B.PROMPT_ID = A.PROMPT_ID AND B.APPLY_YN = 'Y' WHERE 1=1 AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.STAGE_CD = #{stageCd}
mapper.insert: /* PT 프로젝트 등록 proposal.insertProject */ INSERT INTO tb_pt_project ( PT_PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NM, ORG_NM, PROJECT_OVERVIEW, TARGET_TYPE_CD, DUE_DT, STATUS_CD, WRITING_GUIDELINE_JSON, PROJECT_CONFIG_JSON, CREATE_DT, CREATE_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{ptProjectId}, #{projectNm}, #{orgNm}, #{projectOverview}, #{targetTypeCd}, #{dueDt}, #{statusCd}, #{writingGuidelineJson}, #{projectConfigJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createUserId} )
mapper.select: /* PT 프로젝트 단건 조회 proposal.selectProject */ SELECT PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID , PROJECT_NM AS PROJECT_NM , ORG_NM AS ORG_NM , PROJECT_OVERVIEW AS PROJECT_OVERVIEW , TARGET_TYPE_CD AS TARGET_TYPE_CD , DATE_FORMAT(DUE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DUE_DT , STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD , CAST(WRITING_GUIDELINE_JSON AS CHAR) AS WRITING_GUIDELINE_JSON , CAST(PROJECT_CONFIG_JSON AS CHAR) AS PROJECT_CONFIG_JSON , MAX_STEP_NO AS MAX_STEP_NO , STAGE2_STATUS_CD AS STAGE2_STATUS_CD , CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT , MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT FROM TB_PT_PROJECT WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId}

/* PT 파일 단건 조회 proposal.selectPtFileById */ SELECT PT_FILE_ID AS PT_FILE_ID , PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID , FILE_PURPOSE_CD AS FILE_PURPOSE_CD , FILE_PATH AS FILE_PATH , FILE_NM AS FILE_NM , FILE_SIZE AS FILE_SIZE , FILE_TYPE AS FILE_TYPE , CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_FILE WHERE PT_FILE_ID = #{ptFileId}

/* PT 프로젝트의 용도별 파일 조회 (RFP_FILE_ID/EVAL_TABLE_FILE_ID 컬럼 제거 후 대체 쿼리) FILE_PURPOSE_CD (PT000011): 001=RFP원문, 002=평가표, 003=템플릿, 004=기타참고자료, 005=자사정보, 006=경쟁사정보 proposal.selectPtFileByPurpose */ SELECT PT_FILE_ID AS PT_FILE_ID , PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID , FILE_PURPOSE_CD AS FILE_PURPOSE_CD , FILE_PATH AS FILE_PATH , FILE_NM AS FILE_NM , FILE_SIZE AS FILE_SIZE , FILE_TYPE AS FILE_TYPE , CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_FILE WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} AND FILE_PURPOSE_CD = #{filePurposeCd} ORDER BY CREATE_DT DESC

/* PT 요구사항 목록 조회 proposal.selectRequirements */ SELECT r.REQUIREMENT_ID AS REQUIREMENT_ID , r.PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID , r.REQ_NO AS REQ_NO , r.REQ_CATEGORY_TXT AS REQ_CATEGORY_TXT , r.REQ_CONTENT AS REQ_CONTENT , r.REQ_DETAIL_TXT AS REQ_DETAIL_TXT , r.MANDATORY_YN AS MANDATORY_YN , r.SOURCE_TYPE_CD AS SOURCE_TYPE_CD , r.CONFIRM_NEEDED_YN AS CONFIRM_NEEDED_YN , r.SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD , r.CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(r.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_REQUIREMENT r WHERE r.PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY r.SORT_ORD, r.REQUIREMENT_ID

/* PT 평가기준 목록 조회 proposal.selectEvalCriteria */ SELECT EVAL_CRITERIA_ID AS EVAL_CRITERIA_ID , PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID , EVAL_ITEM_NM AS EVAL_ITEM_NM , SCORE AS SCORE , EVAL_INTENT AS EVAL_INTENT , HIGH_SCORE_CONDITION AS HIGH_SCORE_CONDITION , REQUIRED_EVIDENCE AS REQUIRED_EVIDENCE , DIFFERENTIATION_DIRECTION AS DIFFERENTIATION_DIRECTION , SLIDE_REFLECT_POSITION AS SLIDE_REFLECT_POSITION , SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD , CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_EVAL_CRITERIA WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, EVAL_CRITERIA_ID

/* RFP 이슈 목록 조회 proposal.selectRfpIssues */ SELECT ISSUE_ID AS ISSUE_ID , PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID , ISSUE_TYPE_CD AS ISSUE_TYPE_CD , ISSUE_CONTENT AS ISSUE_CONTENT , ISSUE_LABEL AS ISSUE_LABEL , SOURCE_SECTION AS SOURCE_SECTION , SOURCE_PAGE AS SOURCE_PAGE , SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD , CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM tb_pt_rfp_issue WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, ISSUE_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PT_PROBLEM_DEFINITION ( PROBLEM_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, PROBLEM_TYPE_CD, CURRENT_PROBLEM, ROOT_CAUSE, RISK_IF_IGNORED, GOAL, REQUIRED_CAPABILITY, STRATEGY_SUMMARY, KPI, SOURCE_TYPE_CD, SOURCE_ISSUE_IDS_JSON, SOURCE_REQ_IDS_JSON, SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{problemId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{problemTypeCd}, #{currentProblem}, #{rootCause}, #{riskIfIgnored}, #{goal}, #{requiredCapability}, #{strategySummary}, #{kpi}, COALESCE(#{sourceTypeCd}, '002'), #{sourceIssueIdsJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sourceRequirementIdsJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{sortOrd}, 0), #{createUserId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT PROBLEM_ID AS PROBLEM_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, PROBLEM_TYPE_CD AS PROBLEM_TYPE_CD, CURRENT_PROBLEM AS CURRENT_PROBLEM, ROOT_CAUSE AS ROOT_CAUSE, RISK_IF_IGNORED AS RISK_IF_IGNORED, GOAL AS GOAL, REQUIRED_CAPABILITY AS REQUIRED_CAPABILITY, STRATEGY_SUMMARY AS STRATEGY_SUMMARY, KPI AS KPI, SOURCE_TYPE_CD AS SOURCE_TYPE_CD, SOURCE_ISSUE_IDS_JSON AS SOURCE_ISSUE_IDS_JSON, SOURCE_REQ_IDS_JSON AS SOURCE_REQUIREMENT_IDS_JSON, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT, DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT, MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID FROM TB_PT_PROBLEM_DEFINITION WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, PROBLEM_ID

SELECT PROBLEM_ID AS PROBLEM_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, PROBLEM_TYPE_CD AS PROBLEM_TYPE_CD, CURRENT_PROBLEM AS CURRENT_PROBLEM, ROOT_CAUSE AS ROOT_CAUSE, RISK_IF_IGNORED AS RISK_IF_IGNORED, GOAL AS GOAL, REQUIRED_CAPABILITY AS REQUIRED_CAPABILITY, STRATEGY_SUMMARY AS STRATEGY_SUMMARY, KPI AS KPI, SOURCE_TYPE_CD AS SOURCE_TYPE_CD, SOURCE_ISSUE_IDS_JSON AS SOURCE_ISSUE_IDS_JSON, SOURCE_REQ_IDS_JSON AS SOURCE_REQUIREMENT_IDS_JSON, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT, DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT, MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID FROM TB_PT_PROBLEM_DEFINITION WHERE PROBLEM_ID = #{problemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PT_WIN_THEME ( WIN_THEME_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, CORE_MESSAGE, CUSTOMER_PROBLEM, PROPOSAL_STRATEGY, EVIDENCE, EXPECTED_EFFECT, DIFFERENTIATION, SOURCE_PROBLEM_IDS_JSON, SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{winThemeId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{coreMessage}, #{customerProblem}, #{proposalStrategy}, #{evidence}, #{expectedEffect}, #{differentiation}, #{sourceProblemIdsJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{sortOrd}, 0), #{createUserId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT WIN_THEME_ID AS WIN_THEME_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, CORE_MESSAGE AS CORE_MESSAGE, CUSTOMER_PROBLEM AS CUSTOMER_PROBLEM, PROPOSAL_STRATEGY AS PROPOSAL_STRATEGY, EVIDENCE AS EVIDENCE, EXPECTED_EFFECT AS EXPECTED_EFFECT, DIFFERENTIATION AS DIFFERENTIATION, SOURCE_PROBLEM_IDS_JSON AS SOURCE_PROBLEM_IDS_JSON, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT, DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT, MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID FROM TB_PT_WIN_THEME WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, WIN_THEME_ID

SELECT WIN_THEME_ID AS WIN_THEME_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, CORE_MESSAGE AS CORE_MESSAGE, CUSTOMER_PROBLEM AS CUSTOMER_PROBLEM, PROPOSAL_STRATEGY AS PROPOSAL_STRATEGY, EVIDENCE AS EVIDENCE, EXPECTED_EFFECT AS EXPECTED_EFFECT, DIFFERENTIATION AS DIFFERENTIATION, SOURCE_PROBLEM_IDS_JSON AS SOURCE_PROBLEM_IDS_JSON, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT, DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT, MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID FROM TB_PT_WIN_THEME WHERE WIN_THEME_ID = #{winThemeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PT_TOC ( TOC_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, PARENT_TOC_ID, SECTION_NO, SECTION_NM, LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID, COVERED_REQ_IDS_JSON, PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT, SORT_ORD, GUIDE_CONTENT, ORIGIN_TYPE_CD, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{tocId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{parentTocId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sectionNo}, #{sectionNm}, #{linkedEvalCriteriaId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{coveredReqIdsJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{plannedSlideCnt}, COALESCE(#{sortOrd}, 0), #{guideContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{originTypeCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUserId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT t.TOC_ID AS TOC_ID, t.PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, t.PARENT_TOC_ID AS PARENT_TOC_ID, t.SECTION_NO AS SECTION_NO, t.SECTION_NM AS SECTION_NM, t.LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID AS LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID, t.COVERED_REQ_IDS_JSON AS COVERED_REQ_IDS_JSON, t.PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT AS PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT, t.SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, t.GUIDE_CONTENT AS GUIDE_CONTENT, t.ORIGIN_TYPE_CD AS ORIGIN_TYPE_CD, t.CONTENT_OUTLINE_TXT AS CONTENT_OUTLINE_TXT, t.OUTLINE_STATUS_CD AS OUTLINE_STATUS_CD, t.CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(t.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT, t.MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(t.MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT FROM TB_PT_TOC t LEFT JOIN TB_PT_TOC p ON t.PARENT_TOC_ID = p.TOC_ID /* 직계 부모: 소목차(001) 또는 세부목차(002)의 부모인 소목차 */ LEFT JOIN TB_PT_TOC gp ON p.PARENT_TOC_ID = gp.TOC_ID /* 조부모: 세부목차 기준 대목차 */ WHERE t.PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY COALESCE(gp.SORT_ORD, p.SORT_ORD, t.SORT_ORD), /* 1순위: 대목차 그룹 */ COALESCE(CASE WHEN p.PARENT_TOC_ID IS NOT NULL THEN p.SORT_ORD END, t.SORT_ORD), /* 2순위: 소목차 그룹 (대목차 내에서) */ (CASE WHEN t.PARENT_TOC_ID IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN p.PARENT_TOC_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), /* 3순위: 대목차(0)→소목차(1)→세부목차(2) */ t.SORT_ORD, /* 4순위: 같은 레벨 내 형제 순서 */ t.TOC_ID
/* Stage2 실행 여부 확인 proposal.countProblemDefinitions */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PT_PROBLEM_DEFINITION WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId}

/* TOC 단건 조회 proposal.selectTocById */ SELECT TOC_ID AS TOC_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, PARENT_TOC_ID AS PARENT_TOC_ID, SECTION_NO AS SECTION_NO, SECTION_NM AS SECTION_NM, LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID AS LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID, COVERED_REQ_IDS_JSON AS COVERED_REQ_IDS_JSON, PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT AS PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, GUIDE_CONTENT AS GUIDE_CONTENT, CONTENT_OUTLINE_TXT AS CONTENT_OUTLINE_TXT, OUTLINE_STATUS_CD AS OUTLINE_STATUS_CD, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT, MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT FROM TB_PT_TOC WHERE TOC_ID = #{tocId}
/* 콘텐츠 개요 텍스트 단건 조회 proposal.selectTocOutline */ SELECT TOC_ID AS TOC_ID, CONTENT_OUTLINE_TXT AS CONTENT_OUTLINE_TXT, OUTLINE_STATUS_CD AS OUTLINE_STATUS_CD FROM TB_PT_TOC WHERE TOC_ID = #{tocId}

/* 진짜 리프(leaf) TOC 목록 조회 — 자신을 PARENT_TOC_ID로 참조하는 자식이 없는 노드만 반환 proposal.selectLeafTocList */ SELECT TOC_ID AS TOC_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, PARENT_TOC_ID AS PARENT_TOC_ID, SECTION_NO AS SECTION_NO, SECTION_NM AS SECTION_NM, LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID AS LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID, PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT AS PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, GUIDE_CONTENT AS GUIDE_CONTENT, CONTENT_OUTLINE_TXT AS CONTENT_OUTLINE_TXT, OUTLINE_STATUS_CD AS OUTLINE_STATUS_CD FROM TB_PT_TOC WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} AND PARENT_TOC_ID IS NOT NULL AND TOC_ID NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT PARENT_TOC_ID FROM TB_PT_TOC WHERE PARENT_TOC_ID IS NOT NULL AND PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ) ORDER BY SORT_ORD, TOC_ID

/* 다음 리프 TOC 조회 — selectTocList 3단계 정렬 기준으로 현재 tocId 이후 첫 번째 리프 반환 proposal.selectNextLeafToc */ SELECT t.TOC_ID, t.PT_PROJECT_ID, t.PARENT_TOC_ID, t.SECTION_NM, t.SORT_ORD FROM ( SELECT t0.TOC_ID, t0.PT_PROJECT_ID, t0.PARENT_TOC_ID, t0.SECTION_NM, t0.SORT_ORD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY COALESCE(gp.SORT_ORD, p.SORT_ORD, t0.SORT_ORD), COALESCE(CASE WHEN p.PARENT_TOC_ID IS NOT NULL THEN p.SORT_ORD END, t0.SORT_ORD), CASE WHEN t0.PARENT_TOC_ID IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN p.PARENT_TOC_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t0.SORT_ORD, t0.TOC_ID ) AS rn FROM TB_PT_TOC t0 LEFT JOIN TB_PT_TOC p ON t0.PARENT_TOC_ID = p.TOC_ID LEFT JOIN TB_PT_TOC gp ON p.PARENT_TOC_ID = gp.TOC_ID WHERE t0.PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} AND t0.PARENT_TOC_ID IS NOT NULL AND t0.TOC_ID NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT PARENT_TOC_ID FROM TB_PT_TOC WHERE PARENT_TOC_ID IS NOT NULL AND PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ) ) t WHERE t.rn > ( SELECT rn2.rn FROM ( SELECT t2.TOC_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY COALESCE(gp2.SORT_ORD, p2.SORT_ORD, t2.SORT_ORD), COALESCE(CASE WHEN p2.PARENT_TOC_ID IS NOT NULL THEN p2.SORT_ORD END, t2.SORT_ORD), CASE WHEN t2.PARENT_TOC_ID IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN p2.PARENT_TOC_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t2.SORT_ORD, t2.TOC_ID ) AS rn FROM TB_PT_TOC t2 LEFT JOIN TB_PT_TOC p2 ON t2.PARENT_TOC_ID = p2.TOC_ID LEFT JOIN TB_PT_TOC gp2 ON p2.PARENT_TOC_ID = gp2.TOC_ID WHERE t2.PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} AND t2.PARENT_TOC_ID IS NOT NULL AND t2.TOC_ID NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT PARENT_TOC_ID FROM TB_PT_TOC WHERE PARENT_TOC_ID IS NOT NULL AND PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ) ) rn2 WHERE rn2.TOC_ID = #{tocId} ) ORDER BY t.rn LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: /* 슬라이드 등록 proposal.insertSlide */ INSERT INTO TB_PT_SLIDE ( SLIDE_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, TOC_ID, SLIDE_NO, LAYOUT_TYPE_CD, REQ_IDS_JSON, EYEBROW_TXT, TITLE_TXT, SUBTITLE_TXT, HIGHLIGHT_BANNER_TXT, COMPONENTS_JSON, STEP_FLOW_BAR_JSON, CONCLUSION_RIBBON_TXT, COLOR_INDEX, IMAGE_GEN_HINT, RENDER_STATUS_CD, RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH, SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{slideId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{tocId}, #{slideNo}, #{layoutType}, #{reqIdsJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{eyebrowTxt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{titleTxt}, #{subtitleTxt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{highlightBannerTxt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{componentsJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stepFlowBarJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{conclusionRibbonTxt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{colorIndex}, #{imageGenHint, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{renderStatusCd}, '001'), #{renderedImagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{sortOrd}, 0), #{createUserId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: /* 소목차 슬라이드 목록 조회 proposal.selectSlidesByToc */ SELECT SLIDE_ID AS SLIDE_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, TOC_ID AS TOC_ID, SLIDE_NO AS SLIDE_NO, LAYOUT_TYPE_CD AS LAYOUT_TYPE, CAST(REQ_IDS_JSON AS CHAR) AS REQ_IDS_JSON, EYEBROW_TXT AS EYEBROW_TXT, TITLE_TXT AS TITLE_TXT, SUBTITLE_TXT AS SUBTITLE_TXT, HIGHLIGHT_BANNER_TXT AS HIGHLIGHT_BANNER_TXT, CAST(COMPONENTS_JSON AS CHAR) AS COMPONENTS_JSON, CAST(STEP_FLOW_BAR_JSON AS CHAR) AS STEP_FLOW_BAR_JSON, CONCLUSION_RIBBON_TXT AS CONCLUSION_RIBBON_TXT, COLOR_INDEX AS COLOR_INDEX, IMAGE_GEN_HINT AS IMAGE_GEN_HINT, RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH AS RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH, COMPOSITE_IMAGE_PATH AS COMPOSITE_IMAGE_PATH, RENDER_STATUS_CD AS RENDER_STATUS_CD, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT, MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT FROM TB_PT_SLIDE WHERE TOC_ID = #{tocId} ORDER BY SLIDE_NO

/* 슬라이드 단건 조회 proposal.selectSlideById */ SELECT SLIDE_ID AS SLIDE_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, TOC_ID AS TOC_ID, SLIDE_NO AS SLIDE_NO, LAYOUT_TYPE_CD AS LAYOUT_TYPE, CAST(REQ_IDS_JSON AS CHAR) AS REQ_IDS_JSON, EYEBROW_TXT AS EYEBROW_TXT, TITLE_TXT AS TITLE_TXT, SUBTITLE_TXT AS SUBTITLE_TXT, HIGHLIGHT_BANNER_TXT AS HIGHLIGHT_BANNER_TXT, CAST(COMPONENTS_JSON AS CHAR) AS COMPONENTS_JSON, CAST(STEP_FLOW_BAR_JSON AS CHAR) AS STEP_FLOW_BAR_JSON, CONCLUSION_RIBBON_TXT AS CONCLUSION_RIBBON_TXT, COLOR_INDEX AS COLOR_INDEX, IMAGE_GEN_HINT AS IMAGE_GEN_HINT, RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH AS RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH, RENDER_STATUS_CD AS RENDER_STATUS_CD, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT, MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT FROM TB_PT_SLIDE WHERE SLIDE_ID = #{slideId}
mapper.delete: /* 소목차 슬라이드 전체 삭제 proposal.deleteSlidesByToc */ DELETE FROM TB_PT_SLIDE WHERE TOC_ID = #{tocId}
mapper.select: /* 프로젝트 전체 슬라이드 목록 조회 (SLIDE_NO 순) proposal.selectAllSlidesByProject */ SELECT SLIDE_ID AS SLIDE_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, TOC_ID AS TOC_ID, SLIDE_NO AS SLIDE_NO, LAYOUT_TYPE_CD AS LAYOUT_TYPE, CAST(REQ_IDS_JSON AS CHAR) AS REQ_IDS_JSON, EYEBROW_TXT AS EYEBROW_TXT, TITLE_TXT AS TITLE_TXT, SUBTITLE_TXT AS SUBTITLE_TXT, HIGHLIGHT_BANNER_TXT AS HIGHLIGHT_BANNER_TXT, CAST(COMPONENTS_JSON AS CHAR) AS COMPONENTS_JSON, CAST(STEP_FLOW_BAR_JSON AS CHAR) AS STEP_FLOW_BAR_JSON, CONCLUSION_RIBBON_TXT AS CONCLUSION_RIBBON_TXT, COLOR_INDEX AS COLOR_INDEX, IMAGE_GEN_HINT AS IMAGE_GEN_HINT, RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH AS RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH, RENDER_STATUS_CD AS RENDER_STATUS_CD, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT, MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT FROM TB_PT_SLIDE WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY SLIDE_NO
mapper.insert: /* Stage4 평가 시뮬레이션 결과 등록 proposal.insertReview */ INSERT INTO TB_PT_REVIEW ( REVIEW_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, SLIDE_ID, EVAL_CRITERIA_ID, SEVERITY_CD, EVAL_CRITERIA_NM, CURRENT_ISSUE, SCORE_IMPACT, FIX_DIRECTION, FIX_SUGGESTION_TXT, EXPECTED_SCORE, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{slideId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{evalCriteriaId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{severityCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{evalCriteriaNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{currentIssue, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{scoreImpact, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fixDirection, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fixSuggestionTxt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{expectedScore, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{createUserId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW() )
mapper.select: /* 특정 실행 시각의 Stage4 결과 조회 (심각도순) proposal.selectReviewsByRunDt */ SELECT REVIEW_ID AS REVIEW_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, SLIDE_ID AS SLIDE_ID, EVAL_CRITERIA_ID AS EVAL_CRITERIA_ID, SEVERITY_CD AS SEVERITY_CD, EVAL_CRITERIA_NM AS EVAL_CRITERIA_NM, CURRENT_ISSUE AS CURRENT_ISSUE, SCORE_IMPACT AS SCORE_IMPACT, FIX_DIRECTION AS FIX_DIRECTION, FIX_SUGGESTION_TXT AS FIX_SUGGESTION_TXT, EXPECTED_SCORE AS EXPECTED_SCORE, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_REVIEW WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} AND DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') = #{runDt} ORDER BY CASE SEVERITY_CD WHEN '001' THEN 1 WHEN '002' THEN 2 WHEN '003' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, CREATE_DT

/* PT 출력 단건 조회 proposal.selectExportById */ SELECT EXPORT_ID AS EXPORT_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, EXPORT_TYPE_CD AS EXPORT_TYPE_CD, BUILD_STATUS_CD AS BUILD_STATUS_CD, TOTAL_SLIDE_CNT AS TOTAL_SLIDE_CNT, RENDERED_SLIDE_CNT AS RENDERED_SLIDE_CNT, FILE_NM AS FILE_NM, FILE_PATH AS FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE AS FILE_SIZE, INPUT_FINGERPRINT AS INPUT_FINGERPRINT, ERROR_MSG AS ERROR_MSG, DATE_FORMAT(COMPLETE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS COMPLETE_DT, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_EXPORT WHERE EXPORT_ID = #{exportId}

/* 프로젝트+내보내기형식 기준 최근 완료 출력 빌드 조회 (캐시 재사용 판단용) proposal.selectLatestCompletedExport */ SELECT EXPORT_ID AS EXPORT_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, EXPORT_TYPE_CD AS EXPORT_TYPE_CD, BUILD_STATUS_CD AS BUILD_STATUS_CD, TOTAL_SLIDE_CNT AS TOTAL_SLIDE_CNT, RENDERED_SLIDE_CNT AS RENDERED_SLIDE_CNT, FILE_NM AS FILE_NM, FILE_PATH AS FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE AS FILE_SIZE, INPUT_FINGERPRINT AS INPUT_FINGERPRINT, ERROR_MSG AS ERROR_MSG, DATE_FORMAT(COMPLETE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS COMPLETE_DT, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_EXPORT WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} AND EXPORT_TYPE_CD = #{exportTypeCd} AND BUILD_STATUS_CD = '004' ORDER BY COMPLETE_DT DESC LIMIT 1

/* PT 템플릿 단건 조회 (PT_PROJECT_ID 기준) proposal.selectPtTemplate */ SELECT TEMPLATE_ID AS TEMPLATE_ID , PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID , CAST(HEADER_COMPONENTS_JSON AS CHAR) AS HEADER_COMPONENTS_JSON , CAST(FOOTER_COMPONENTS_JSON AS CHAR) AS FOOTER_COMPONENTS_JSON , CAST(COLOR_JSON AS CHAR) AS COLOR_JSON , GEN_STATUS_CD AS GEN_STATUS_CD , ERROR_MSG AS ERROR_MSG , FRAME_IMAGE_PATH AS FRAME_IMAGE_PATH , COVER_IMAGE_PATH AS COVER_IMAGE_PATH , COVER_GEN_STATUS_CD AS COVER_GEN_STATUS_CD , DIVIDER_IMAGE_PATH AS DIVIDER_IMAGE_PATH , DIVIDER_GEN_STATUS_CD AS DIVIDER_GEN_STATUS_CD , CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT , MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT FROM TB_PT_TEMPLATE WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId}
mapper.insert: /* PT 템플릿 신규 등록 proposal.insertPtTemplate */ INSERT INTO TB_PT_TEMPLATE ( TEMPLATE_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, HEADER_COMPONENTS_JSON, FOOTER_COMPONENTS_JSON, COLOR_JSON, GEN_STATUS_CD, ERROR_MSG, CREATE_DT, CREATE_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{templateId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{headerComponentsJson}, #{footerComponentsJson}, #{colorJson}, #{genStatusCd}, #{errorMsg}, NOW(), #{createUserId} )
